summary: netapp.ontap in Ansible 14 updated the ONTAP personality check, added REST-only autoupdate_config and consistency group modules (ONTAP 9.10.1+), and AWS Lambda support for many CIFS, igroup, interface, iSCSI and other modules.
questions: Which ONTAP version do na_ontap_cg and na_ontap_autoupdate_config need?

answer_card.title: netapp.ontap 14.0.0 changes (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- Updated ONTAP personality check.
- `na_ontap_autoupdate_config` and `na_ontap_cg` (consistency groups): REST-only, ONTAP **9.10.1+**.
- AWS Lambda support added to CIFS modules, `na_ontap_cluster_peer`, `na_ontap_debug`, `na_ontap_dns`, `na_ontap_domain_tunnel`, `na_ontap_efficiency_policy`, export policy modules, `na_ontap_flexcache`, igroup modules, `na_ontap_interface`, iSCSI modules and `na_ontap_job_schedule`.
